name: NFWF Pacific Seabird Program
summary: Grants for Pacific seabird conservation: invasive predator management, breeding habitat restoration, colony establishment, bycatch reduction and monitoring. The 2026 call covered the California Current, Hawaii, the Humboldt Current and the central tropical Pacific.

geography.label: Four Pacific geographies: California Current, Hawaiian Archipelago, Humboldt Current, central tropical Pacific

deadline.text: Monday, August 24, 2026, by 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time

status.quote: Full Proposal Due Date: Monday, August 24, 2026, by 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date: Monday, August 24, 2026, by 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: non-profit 501(c) organizations, Federal government agencies, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal Governments and Organizations, educational institutions and international organizations.

geography.quote: The 2026 Request for Proposals (RFP) will consider projects from four broad geographies within the Pacific: 1) California Current, 2) Hawaiian Archipelago, 3) Humboldt Current, and 4) locations in the central tropical Pacific

access.quote: (NFWF) is accepting proposals that implement actions in support of business plan focal seabird species.

window.quote: during this single call for proposals

amount.quote: in 2026 awards should fall within a broad range of $50,000 to $750,000.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum of a 1:1 match (federal and non-federal match are eligible) of cash and/or in-kind services is required.
